description: Stereo wavetable oscillator with morphing between waves and a swarm mode that runs many oscillators at once

params.text: How much of the voltage at the octave CV input reaches the octave
How much of the voltage at the FM input reaches the pitch
How much of the voltage at the LIN FM input reaches the pitch
The level of the stereo output
How much of the voltage at the pulse width CV input reaches the pulse width
How much of the voltage at the bank CV input reaches the bank
How much of the voltage at the wave CV input reaches the wave
Switches the swarm on, so many oscillators sound at once instead of one
How far apart in frequency the oscillators of the swarm are spread; with a cable in the swarm FREQ input the knob sets how much of that voltage is used instead
How far apart in pulse width the oscillators of the swarm are spread; with a cable in the swarm PW input the knob sets how much of that voltage is used instead
How far apart across the banks the oscillators of the swarm are spread; with a cable in the swarm BANK input the knob sets how much of that voltage is used instead
How far apart across the waves the oscillators of the swarm are spread; with a cable in the swarm WAVE input the knob sets how much of that voltage is used instead
Makes changes of bank and of wave slide from one to the next rather than jumping
Blocks the DC that the pulse width setting can build up on the output
Tunes the oscillator by up to a semitone either way

inputs.text: A voltage moving the octave the oscillator plays in
The pitch of the oscillator, one volt per octave
A voltage frequency modulating the oscillator exponentially
A voltage frequency modulating the oscillator linearly
A voltage moving the pulse width
A voltage moving which bank the oscillator reads from
A voltage moving which wave of the bank the oscillator reads
A voltage spreading the oscillators of the swarm in frequency
A voltage spreading the oscillators of the swarm in pulse width
A voltage spreading the oscillators of the swarm across the banks
A voltage spreading the oscillators of the swarm across the waves

outputs.text: The left side of the stereo output
The right side of the stereo output

notes: the oscillator holds 64 banks of 64 waves of 256 samples, and banks are loaded by dropping files or whole folders onto it; WaveEdit, Morphing Terrarium and Piston Honda mk3 tables all read
each CV and VCA group has a pair of displays beside it, one carrying the number that is set and the other the number actually in use once its CV is added
the large panel shows the banks as a book to be browsed by dragging, and the small grids show the wave the oscillator is reading and the wave coming out
a default bank is loaded whenever a new module is created, so it sounds before anything is imported
the default bank is read from sevenseas_default.wav in the plugin's res folder, and replacing that file changes what a new module starts with
menu: POWER MODE — sets how much work the oscillator does per sample: LOW POWER, MEDIUM POWER or HCF MODE
MULTITHREADED — runs the oscillator on an extra thread; on macOS it starts switched off

inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
